theorems.name: Submission.dsmc_em_exp_monotoneOn_of_deriv_ineq
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (κ r : ℝ) (I I' : ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn I (Ioc 0 r) → (∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 r, HasDerivAt I (I' s) s) → (∀ s ∈ Ioo 0 r, (n : ℝ) * I s - s * I' s ≤ κ * s * I s) → MonotoneOn (fun s => Real.exp (κ * s) / s ^ n * I s) (Ioc 0 r)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
